name: Debate
description: Two debaters argue opposing positions on a motion over a configurable number of rounds. An odd-sized AI jury watches silently, then votes. Majority wins. Powered by the judged-contest engine — change the `topic` parameter to motion-on-anything.

phases.name: contest
phases.description: Debaters present and rebut arguments. Judges observe silently.

phases.name: verdict
phases.description: Judges deliberate and vote. Majority wins.

entity_types.name: Contestant
entity_types.description: A debater who argues their assigned position and tries to win the jury's vote.

properties.name: is_winner
properties.description: True after the jury declares them the winner.

entity_types.name: Judge
entity_types.description: A jury member who watches the entire debate and casts one vote at the end.

properties.name: harshness
properties.description: How critically the judge scores weak arguments

properties.name: voted_for
properties.description: Contestant entity_id this judge voted for. Empty until verdict.

actions.name: make_argument
actions.description: Present your argument for this round. REQUIRED parameter `text`: the actual statement you want to deliver to the jury. Only contestants act in the contest phase.

actions.name: cast_vote
actions.description: Cast your single vote for the contestant you believe won the debate overall. REQUIRED parameter `winner`: the entity_id of the contestant you're voting for.

personas.persona_text: You argue FOR the motion. Build a structured, evidence-led case. Engage your opponent's strongest points head-on.
You argue AGAINST the motion. Find the weakest links in the affirmative's case and dismantle them. Offer the better alternative.
Old-school judge — rewards structure, logic, and clean argumentation. Penalizes hand-waving and fallacies.
goals: Cast a fair vote based on logical strength.

personas.persona_text: Rewards charisma, presence, and the ability to move a room. Wit and timing matter to you as much as content.
goals: Cast a fair vote weighted toward performance.

personas.persona_text: Balanced judge — weighs substance and style equally. Looks for the contestant who landed cleaner punches without losing composure.
goals: Cast a fair vote weighing both sides.

params.topic: Should AI agents replace human moderators in online communities?

runtime_parameters.name: sample_size
runtime_parameters.label: Total Contestants
runtime_parameters.description: Debate is strictly 1v1 — two debaters, plus the AI jury.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.judged_contest.topic
runtime_parameters.label: Motion / Topic
runtime_parameters.default: Should AI agents replace human moderators in online communities?
presets: Should AI agents replace human moderators in online communities?
Is universal basic income a net good for society?
Should social media platforms be regulated like public utilities?
Is remote work better than office work for knowledge workers?
Is nuclear energy the solution to climate change?
Should voting be mandatory in democratic elections?

runtime_parameters.name: domain.judged_contest.contest_rounds
runtime_parameters.label: Debate Rounds
runtime_parameters.description: Back-and-forth rounds before the jury votes. Odd-only — one side always gets the closing statement.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.judged_contest.jury_size
runtime_parameters.label: Jury Size
runtime_parameters.description: Number of judges. Odd-only so a tie is impossible.

termination_conditions.name: verdict_reached
termination_conditions.description: End when the jury has rendered its verdict.
